reviews.comment: The queue takes a YouTube playlist, a torrent and a plain HTTP file side by side and none of them get in each other's way. Resume after a dropped connection has worked every time so far.
Runs well on Linux. The browser extension picked up the stream on the first try; I would like more control over folder rules.
Good for daily use, still beta in places.
Scheduled a large download for the night and it was waiting for me in the morning.
Magnet links go straight into the same queue as everything else.
